subject: AI Leaders Dinner - Palo Alto - 30th July
text:

safety model release, and have since met a few of your MLEs at CVPR this

subject: Multimodal Annotation for Content Understanding
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you lead the development of multimodal AI systems at IAS so I wanted
to reach out for a quick chat. We've been working on content classification
projects with DoubleVerify, GumGum and Zefr, naturally IAS has been on our
radar.

For context - we help over 200 AI teams improve quality of training data.
Media measurement teams typically leverage our UI to curate and annotate
multimodal data natively, as well our workflow builder to integrate their
models for auto-labelling & ensure effective QA with human feedback.

Let me know if you're open to exchange perspectives? Quite flexible
Tuesdays to Thursdays if you have a preferred time.

subject: Video-native autolabelling for jobsite monitoring
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded a customer who moved from FiftyOne + CVAT setup,
mentioning the benefit of consolidating data curation and annotation
tooling in one place as well the efficiency gain in performing object
tracking on a video-native interface. So I wanted to reach out for a quick
chat.

Protex AI and Conxai who are in similar space to you. They come to us to
handle video dataset natively and at scale, resulting in greater
consistency on labelling over an accelerated process.

Would you be open to share perspectives on your current setup? Quite
flexible Wednesdays to Fridays if you have a preferred time.
